excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

content.text: If you're an ebook creator in Kenya, you're likely tired of the infrastructure restrictions that come with using popular platforms like Stripe or PayPal. Kenya's creators are part of a growing number of entrepreneurs worldwide who are finding themselves locked out of international payment systems due to local regulations or network issues. But what if you could bypass these restrictions entirely and sell your ebooks directly to international buyers, without relying on a third-party platform? In this post, we'll show you how to do just that, using a combination of blockchain-based payments and cloud infrastructure that removes geographic barriers entirely. With the right tools and knowledge, you can take control of your sales pipeline and sell your ebooks to anyone, anywhere in the world, without the need for a Stripe or PayPal account.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal is that they rely on a complex web of intermediaries and third-party services to facilitate transactions. But these intermediaries can often be a point of failure, particularly in regions with restrictive payment systems or limited internet access. By leveraging blockchain-based payments and cloud infrastructure, you can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of these intermediaries, allowing you to sell your ebooks directly to international buyers without relying on a third-party platform. This infrastructure is not only more secure, but also more reliable and flexible, giving you the freedom to sell your ebooks wherever and however you want.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start selling your ebooks using this infrastructure, you'll need to gather a few key tools and resources. First, you'll need a domain name and a cloud hosting service like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. You'll also need a payment service like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has no KYC requirements. Finally, you'll need a digital storage service like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your ebook files. With these tools in place, you'll be ready to deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack and start selling your ebooks to international buyers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools and resources in place, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring your payment service to receive payments from international buyers, and setting up a delivery mechanism to send your ebooks to customers once payment has been received. With blockchain-based payments, you can automate this process entirely, using webhooks to trigger the delivery of your ebook files as soon as payment is confirmed on-chain. This not only saves time and effort, but also ensures that your sales pipeline is secure, reliable, and transparent.
You don't need a Stripe or PayPal account to sell your ebooks to international buyers.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. This involves deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack to your cloud hosting service, and configuring your payment service to receive payments from international buyers. Once payment is received, your infrastructure will automatically trigger the delivery of your ebook files to the customer, using the digital storage service you set up earlier. With this process in place, you can start selling your ebooks to international buyers and earning revenue from your digital sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is up and running, it's time to scale and take your digital sales to the next level. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can easily add new products, configure new payment options, and optimize your delivery pipeline to ensure maximum efficiency and reliability. By leveraging cloud infrastructure and blockchain-based payments, you can scale your sales pipeline to meet the demands of international buyers, without relying on a third-party platform or intermediaries.
